image_description: A low-angle shot of a large pipe organ installed in a church or concert hall balcony. The image features a prominent wooden case with ornate carvings and multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes. The upper section shows a dramatic array of tall, thin pipes fanning outwards, while the lower section contains a more compact set of pipes behind a decorative wooden facade. The lighting is warm, highlighting the wood grain and metallic sheen of the pipes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Multiple rows of vertical metal or wooden pipes of varying heights arranged symmetrically.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays symmetrical arrangements of vertical pipes in both the upper and lower sections of the instrument.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pipe heights range from very short compact pipes to dramatically towering pipes creating a dramatic stepped silhouette.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a clear visual contrast between the shorter pipes in the central lower division and the very tall, towering pipes in the upper division, creating a stepped profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Console with one or more stacked keyboards (manuals) plus pedalboard at floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The console (keyboards and pedals) is typically located at the base of the organ or on the floor, which is outside the frame of this upward-looking shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Stop knobs or tablets arranged on either side of keyboards.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Stop knobs are part of the console, which is not visible in this image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pedalboard at floor level for foot-operated notes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pedalboard is at floor level and not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ornate carved wood case with decorative moldings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wooden housing surrounding the pipes features visible decorative moldings and carved details, particularly around the central lower pipe array.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Polished tin, lead alloy, or wood pipes with reflective metallic or stained finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pipes exhibit a metallic sheen consistent with polished tin or lead alloys, reflecting the ambient light.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large keyboard instrument with pipe array.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structure is unmistakably a large pipe organ based on the characteristic arrangement of pipes and casing.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument as a pipe organ and distinguish it from other architectural structures.
To verify the physical separation between the foreground pipes and the background wall/ceiling, ensuring no 'melting' or spatial grounding errors in the complex geometry.
To check for boundary sharpness and ensure individual pipes are distinct entities without fusion or bleeding into the wooden case.
To assess general image quality, looking for subtle texture anomalies or warping in the wood grain and metal reflections.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between metal pipes and wooden case
Structural integrity of the upper pipe fan
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the upper section where the pipes fan out; AI often struggles with the consistent perspective and spacing of many thin parallel objects. Check if the pipes merge into the background or each other. Verify that the wood grain on the case looks natural and not smeared.
